title: Access-control-list configuration schema
description: Validation schema for conf/access-control-list.conf.yaml: framework-defined whole-resource RBAC. Roles are defined by the framework as named privilege sets (one artifact schema slug plus one action verb). Actors map those roles to framework agents (files in the framework's agents/ directory, identified by their frontmatter `name` slug).

actors.description: Mapping of framework-defined roles to the framework agents that hold them. Agents are defined as `.agent.md` files in the framework's agents/ directory and identified by their frontmatter `name` slug.

roles.description: Framework-defined privilege sets. Each role is a slug-named set of privileges; each privilege is one artifact schema slug plus one action verb (CREATE|READ|UPDATE|DELETE).

actor.description: One actor declaration: a framework agent (identified by its frontmatter `name` slug) and the roles assigned to it.

roles.description: Role slugs assigned to this actor.

role.description: One role declaration: a slug-named set of privileges.

slug.description: The role slug referenced by actors.

privileges.description: The privileges granted to holders of this role.

action.description: The action verb (CREATE, READ, UPDATE, DELETE) permitted on the artifact.

agentSlug.description: URL-safe slug identifying a framework agent (matches the agent file's frontmatter `name` value, e.g. product-manager).

artifactSlug.description: URL-safe slug naming an artifact kind — the stem of the artifact schema filename (e.g. product-vision from product-vision.artifact.schema.json).
